section_summary: This section records the end of informal arrangements for visits by Japanese and American unarmed public vessels and the adoption of reciprocal advance notification through diplomatic channels. It also documents proposed visits by the Japanese transports Tsurumi, Sata, and Ondo and the training ship Kaio Maru, including arrangements for customary courtesies. Several vessels arrived earlier than announced, prompting Navy complaints and State Department representations to the Japanese Ambassador.

subfiles.title: Japanese proposal to end informal vessel-visit agreements
subfiles.about: Japan accepts advance notification and proposes ending the 1930 and 1931 informal agreements.
subfiles.summary: Japan accepts advance notification and proposes ending the reciprocal informal arrangements for unarmed public vessels.

subfiles.title: Request for War Department views on termination
subfiles.from: William Phillips, Under Secretary of State
subfiles.to: Harry H. Woodring, Acting Secretary of War
subfiles.about: State requests War Department views on Japan’s proposal to end the informal arrangements.
subfiles.summary: Encloses the Japanese note and the July circular on advance notification; seeks War Department views.

subfiles.title: Copy of Japanese Ambassador’s October 21 note
subfiles.about: Japan proposes reciprocal diplomatic notification in place of the informal arrangements.
subfiles.summary: Copy of Japan’s acceptance of notification requirements and proposal to abolish the earlier agreements.

subfiles.title: Circular on notification of foreign public-vessel visits
subfiles.about: Foreign missions are asked to notify State before naval or other public vessels enter U.S. ports.
subfiles.summary: Requests prior diplomatic notification except where special arrangements apply.

subfiles.title: Request for Navy Department views on termination
subfiles.from: William Phillips, Under Secretary of State
subfiles.to: Claude A. Swanson, Secretary of the Navy
subfiles.about: State requests Navy Department views on terminating the informal vessel-visit agreements.
subfiles.summary: Encloses the Japanese proposal and asks whether Navy supports ending the reciprocal informal arrangements.

subfiles.title: Copy of Japanese Ambassador’s October 21 note
subfiles.about: Japan accepts advance notification and proposes abolishing the informal arrangements.
subfiles.summary: Duplicate copy of the Japanese note concerning unarmed public vessels.

subfiles.title: Conversation on termination date
subfiles.about: Dooman and Commander Hill discuss Navy concurrence and a December 31 termination date.
subfiles.summary: Hill says Navy has approved concurrence with Japan’s proposal. He expects the informal arrangements to end December 31, after Gold Star completes its Japanese port visits.

subfiles.title: Gold Star port-visit request
subfiles.about: Navy forwards a request for Gold Star to visit Miike and Nagasaki in December.
subfiles.summary: Quotes a telegram requesting diplomatic arrangements for Gold Star’s Japanese port calls.

subfiles.title: Navy concurrence with Japanese termination proposal
subfiles.about: Navy agrees to end the informal arrangements once a termination date is fixed.
subfiles.summary: Navy requests the date so it can instruct naval officials.

subfiles.title: U.S. acceptance of termination proposal
subfiles.about: The United States accepts termination and proposes December 31 for reciprocal notification to begin.
subfiles.summary: State accepts Japan’s proposal to terminate the 1930 and 1931 arrangements. It suggests December 31, 1935, as the effective date, after which both governments would give prior notice through diplomatic channels.

subfiles.summary: Customs collectors at Los Angeles and Honolulu are being instructed.

subfiles.about: Navy has no objection to Sata’s proposed visits.

subfiles.title: Hawaii governor’s reply on Tsurumi
subfiles.from: Joseph Boyd Poindexter, Governor of Hawaii
subfiles.about: Hawaii will extend customary port courtesies to Tsurumi.
subfiles.summary: The governor confirms arrangements; Interior forwards the letter to State.

subfiles.title: Navy complaint about Sata’s early arrival
subfiles.about: Navy reports Sata arrived at San Pedro ahead of its announced schedule.
subfiles.summary: Requests an updated Honolulu arrival date and advance notice of future schedule changes.

subfiles.title: Embassy inquiry about Sata’s Honolulu arrival
subfiles.about: The Japanese Embassy cannot determine Sata’s Honolulu arrival after its early departure.
subfiles.summary: Records Commander Hill’s inquiry and the Embassy’s response.

subfiles.title: State protest over Sata’s early arrival
subfiles.about: State raises Sata’s arrival at Los Angeles before its announced date.
subfiles.summary: Cites the December 11 arrival instead of December 16 and objects to unannounced schedule changes.

subfiles.summary: Records calls requesting customary courtesies and notes that State will protest.

subfiles.title: Far Eastern Affairs note on Kaio Maru
subfiles.about: Navy reports Kaio Maru is arriving at Hilo before the date announced by Japan.
subfiles.summary: Records Commander Hill’s warning and the late receipt of the Japanese note.

subfiles.title: Immigration radiogram on Kaio Maru
subfiles.about: Immigration is directed to extend courtesies to Kaio Maru at Hilo.
subfiles.summary: Transmits State’s request for customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Proposed visit of Kaio Maru
subfiles.about: Japan requests approval for Kaio Maru’s Hilo visit and landing of crew and students.
subfiles.summary: Names Captain Kichitaro Miyamoto and announces a January 5–12 visit.

subfiles.title: Kaio Maru visit: confirmation to Navy
subfiles.about: State confirms its emergency request for courtesies despite Kaio Maru’s earlier arrival.
subfiles.summary: Contrasts the announced January visit with Navy’s report of a December 27 arrival and confirms the telephone request.

subfiles.title: Kaio Maru visit: confirmation to War
subfiles.about: State confirms its telephone request for courtesies to Kaio Maru.
subfiles.summary: Explains the discrepancy between announced and reported arrival dates.

subfiles.title: Kaio Maru visit: confirmation to Labor
subfiles.about: State confirms its telephone request for courtesies to Kaio Maru.
subfiles.summary: Explains the discrepancy between announced and reported arrival dates.

subfiles.summary: Confirms reciprocal advance notification through diplomatic channels thereafter.

subfiles.summary: Recommends transmitting copies of three diplomatic notes.

subfiles.summary: Encloses Japan’s December 26 note and confirms a telephone conversation.

subfiles.title: Instruction to Embassy in Tokyo
subfiles.about: State sends correspondence establishing reciprocal advance notification for unarmed public vessels.
subfiles.summary: Informs the Embassy that the 1930 and 1931 arrangements have ended.

subfiles.title: Notice to War of agreed termination
subfiles.about: State sends War correspondence ending the informal agreements.
subfiles.summary: Provides copies for the Bureau of Insular Affairs.

subfiles.summary: Reports instructions to the Hawaiian Department and Ninth Corps Area.

subfiles.about: Navy has no objection to Ondo’s visits.
subfiles.summary: Navy has notified local officials.

subfiles.title: Treasury arrangements for Ondo
subfiles.about: Treasury instructs customs officials to extend courtesies to Ondo.
subfiles.summary: Confirms telegram and letter to Los Angeles and Honolulu collectors.

subfiles.title: Customs report on Kaio Maru
subfiles.from: George W. Ashworth, Bureau of Customs
subfiles.to: Assistant Chief, Division of Protocol and Conferences
subfiles.about: Customs confirms a radiogram authorizing courtesies for Kaio Maru.
subfiles.summary: Reports the Honolulu collector was instructed after State’s December 27 call.

subfiles.title: Customs radiogram for Kaio Maru
subfiles.about: Customs is directed to extend courtesies to Kaio Maru at Hilo.
subfiles.summary: Telegram cites State’s request and December 27 visit.

subfiles.title: Immigration arrangements for Ondo
subfiles.about: Immigration officials will extend courtesies to Ondo’s personnel.
subfiles.summary: Confirms wire instructions to representatives at Los Angeles and Honolulu.

subfiles.title: War Department arrangements for Kaio Maru
subfiles.about: War confirms instructions to extend courtesies to Kaio Maru.
subfiles.summary: Reports a December 27 cable to the Hawaiian Department.

subfiles.title: Copy of War Department letter on Kaio Maru
subfiles.about: War confirms instructions to extend courtesies to Kaio Maru.
subfiles.summary: Duplicate copy of the preceding War Department reply.

subfiles.title: Navy complaint about early arrivals
subfiles.about: Navy reports early arrivals by Kaio Maru and Ondo and seeks advance notice of changes.
subfiles.summary: Lists arrivals ahead of approved dates and asks State to raise the issue with Japanese officials.

subfiles.title: State protest over Ondo’s early arrival
subfiles.about: State objects to Ondo arriving at Los Angeles before the announced January 7 date.
subfiles.summary: Ondo arrived January 3. State requests that Japanese public vessels adhere to schedules announced in advance.

subfiles.title: State protest over Kaio Maru’s early arrival
subfiles.about: State raises Kaio Maru’s arrival at Hilo before its announced January visit.
subfiles.summary: Opening page of a note contrasting the announced January 5 arrival with reports of a December 27 entry.
